enchant_guidance.text:
Band of Devastation, Unstoppable Aggressor's Ring, Ring of Deceitful Intent, and Ring of Lethality are viable, if weaker, alternatives.
Recommended BiS Ring Enchant:  - Only Enchanters may apply Ring Enchants on their own rings.
